spans.s: 1. उपम॑ mf(आ)n. uppermost, highest
most excellent, eminent, best, RV.; AV.
nearest, next, first, RV.; Nigh.
2. उपम mfn. ifc. for 3. उप-मा, q.v.
1. उपमा॑ (for 2. See below, and for 3. See col. 3) ind. (Ved. instr. of the above) in the closest proximity or neighbourhood, RV. i, 31, 15; viii, 69, 13.
Impv. 2
. sg. -मिमीहि, -माहि, and -मास्व;
Subj. 2
. sg. -मासि) to measure out to, apportion to, assign, allot, grant, give, RV. : Ā. -मिमीते, to measure one thing by another, compare, MBh.; Hariv.; Caurap. &c.
3. उप-मा॑ f. comparison, resemblance, equality, similarity
a resemblance (as a picture, portrait &c.), ŚBr.; MBh.; Kum. &c.
a particular figure in rhetoric, simile, comparison (a full simile must include four things; see पूर्णोपम, लुप्तोपमा, &c.), Sāh.; Kāvyād.; Vām. &c.
a particle of comparison, Nir.
a particular metre, RPrāt.
(mfn. ifc.) equal, similar, resembling, like (e.g. अमरोपम mfn. resembling an immortal), MBh.; Ragh.; Daś.; Hit. &c.
उपम॑—श्रवस् mfn. of highest fame, highly renowned
उपम॑—श्रवस् m. N. of a son of Kuru-śravaṇa and grandson of Mitrātithi, RV. x, 33, 6; 7
उपम—श्रवस्—तम mfn. highly renowned, illustrious, RV. ii, 23, 1.
in the highest degree, RV. v, 34, 9; AV. viii, 3, 65; SV.
उप-√ मज्ज् P. Ā. -मज्जति, -ते, to dive, sink, ŚBr.; Lāṭy.; ŚāṅkhŚr. Comm. on KātyŚr.
ablution, bathing, a bath, BhP.

उप-√ मथ् P. -मन्थति, to whirl around, RV. x, 136, 7;
to stir, churn, mix, TBr. i, 6, 8, 4; 5.
stirred, churned, mixed, ŚBr. ii, 6, 1, 6; Kauś.
ind.p. having stirred
churning, mixing, Kauś.; ChUp.
stirring up, Kauś.
a staff for stirring, ŚBr.
See above.
one who stirs or churns (butter &c.), VS. xxx, 12.
उप-√ 1. मद् P. -मदति, to cheer up, encourage, ŚBr. i, 4, 2, 1.
enjoyment, amusement, RV. iii, 5, 5.
See उप-√ मद्.
N. of a younger brother of Madgu, Hariv.; VP.
(scil. अङ्गुलि) the finger next to the middle finger, the last finger but one, ĀpŚr. iii, 1, 2.
उपा-√ मन्त्र्
the art of persuading coaxing (= रहस्य् उप-च्छन्दनम्, Kāś.), Pāṇ. i, 3, 47.
called near or hither, ŚBr.; ChUp. &c.
summoned, invited, persuaded, MBh.; Hariv.
addressed, Daś.
addressed, called upon, summoned, BhP.
1. उप-मन्त्रि॑न् mfn. persuading, inciting, impelling, RV. ix, 112, 4.
2. उप-मन्त्रिन् m. a subordinate counsellor, BhP.
striving after, zealous [BRD.], RV. i, 102, 9
(knowing, understanding, intelligent, Sāy.)
(उस्), m. N. of a Ṛṣi (pupil of Āyoda-dhaumya, who aided Śiva in the propagation of his doctrine and received the ocean of milk from him), MBh.; LiṅgaP.; Kathās. &c.
(अवस्), m. pl. the descendants of the above, ĀśvŚr. (cf. औपमन्यव.)
&c. See उप-√ मृद्.
friction, rubbing down
pressure, Sāh.; Kathās.
injury, violation
destruction, MBh. Comm. on BṛĀrUp. & Nyāyad.
suppression (of a sound), Nyāyad. ii, 2, 59.
उप-मा—द्रव्य n. any object used for comparison, Kum.
उप-मा—रूपक n. (in rhet.) a particular figure combining comparison and metaphor, Vām.
उप-मा—व्यतिरेक m. (in rhet.) a particular figure combining comparison and contrast, Kāvyād.
the tree Vatica Robusta, L.
(वृक्षाणां मध्ये तस्य सर्वोच्चत्वाद् अन्यस्योपोमानतां प्राप्तत्वात् तथात्वम्, T.)
1. उ॑प-माति f. (for 2. See s.v.), इस् comparison, similarity [Sāy.], RV.
‘assigning or granting’ (wealth), N. of Agni [Sāy.], RV. viii, 60, 11
(BRD. derives both 1. and 2. उप-माति fr. उप-√ मन्, ‘to address’.)
2. उप-माति f. (√ 1. मी, Sāy.), destroying, killing.
1. उप-मातृ mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) one who compares, Naiṣ.
an image-maker, portrait-painter, L.
2. उप-मातृ f. ‘second mother’, foster-mother, nurse, L.
a near female relative, L.
comparison, resemblance, analogy, MBh.; Suśr.; Kathās. &c.
simile
the object with which anything is compared, Pāṇ.; Sāh.; Kum. &c.
a particle of comparison, Nir.
(in log.) recognition of likeness, comparison (the third of the four Pramāṇas or means of correct knowledge)
similar, like, Kathās.
उप-मान—चिन्ता-मणि m. N. of a philosophical work.
उप-मान—ता f.
उप-मान—त्व n. similarity, Kathās.
the state of being an object of comparison, Sāh.; Vām.
उप-मान—वत् mfn. similar, like, Śatr.
the connection between the thing to be compared and the object with which it is compared.
1. उप-मित mfn. (for 2. See उप-√ मि) compared, illustrated by comparison, Pāṇ.; Bhartṛ. &c.
similar.
2. उप-मित (for 1. See above) mfn. stuck or fastened on, put into, Vait.
comparison
resemblance, likeness, similarity, Sāh.
analogy
knowledge of things derived from analogy or resemblance, Sarvad.
to be compared, comparable with (with instr. or ifc.), Megh.; Kum. &c.
that which is compared, the subject of comparison (opposed to उप-मान, the object with which anything is compared), Sāh. Comm. on Pāṇ.
the resemblance of any object to that compared with it
reciprocal comparison (as of a moon to a beautiful face), Vām.; Kpr.
a prop, support = उपमि॑त् below [Sāy.], RV. vi, 67, 6.
उप-माति—व॑नि mfn. engaged in killing enemies, destroyer of enemies [Sāy.], RV. v, 41, 16

etym.s: fr. उप-√ मन्, one who receives addresses in a friendly way, BRD.

spans.s: See उप-√ मृ.
the act of throwing into water, submerging, KātyŚr. xx, 8, 22.
a particular metre.
near the banks of the Mālinī, Śak. 16, 7.
, occurring every month, monthly, AV. viii, 10, 19.
उप-√ 1. मि P. -मिनोति, to stick or fasten on, put into, Kāṭh.
त्, f. a prop, stay, RV. i, 59, 1; iv, 5, 1; AV. ix, 3, 1.
a minor friend, not an intimate friend, Nīlak.
उप-√ मिह् Caus. -मेहयति, to wet, BhP. vi, 16, 32.
, deliberation, investigation, consideration, ŚBr. xi, 4, 2, 12; 15.
on the mouth, Lāṭy. iv, 2, 6.
उप-√ मुच् Ā. -मुञ्चते, to put on (e.g. shoes), TS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.
on or at the root, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.; Gobh.

उप-√ मृ Caus. -मारयति, to throw into water, plunge, immerse, ŚBr. Comm. on KātyŚr.;
 (with अप्सु), ĀpŚr. viii, 8, 12.
उप-√ मॄ Pass. (p. -मूर्य॑माण) to be worn away or destroyed, ŚBr. i, 7, 3, 21; 4, 12.
(Pass. -मूर्यते), to be destroyed, ŚBr.
died, dead, TS. vi, 2, 8, 6.

उप-√ मृज् P. -मार्ष्टि (3. pl. -मृजन्ति, RV. ix, 15, 7) to stroke;
to touch, sweep, wipe, cleanse, TBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
destroying, annulling, oppressing, Hariv.; Kathās.; Sarvad.
the act of injuring, violation
suppression, oppression Comm. on KātyŚr.
ifc. destroying, annulling, BhP.
उप-√ मृष् Caus.
borne patiently, tolerated
granted, not begrudged, MBh.
about or on the slopes or sides (of a mountain), Kir. vii, 32.
उप-√ म्लुच् P. (pf. -मुम्लोच) to hide one's self among (with gen.), ŚBr. i, 2, 5, 8.
उप-√ म्लुप्
hidden, concealed, TBr. iii, 2, 9, 4.
ind.p. having addressed, addressing, summoning, R.; BhP.
taking leave, bidding adieu, MBh.; Hariv.
